name: Maximum-rate initial screen
value_or_description: Highest registered application rate for each crop/use; conservative lower seed mass where applicable.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Lower seed mass increases estimated concentration/exposure.

name: Screening diet
value_or_description: 100% of daily energy/diet is treated seed of the crop being screened.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Assessment later refines accessibility and dietary fraction.
notes: Refined tables use multiple dietary fractions.

name: Complete screening transformation
value_or_description: 100% conversion of thiamethoxam to clothianidin using molar mass ratio 249.68/291.7 = 0.856.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Explicitly conservative screening assumption.
notes: Refined assessment uses a different transformation convention.

name: Refined clothianidin contribution
value_or_description: No quantitative refined exposure to clothianidin from ingestion of thiamethoxam-treated seed.
scope: Refined bird and mammal seed-ingestion assessment
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Uncertainty stated because no study directly examined conversion on treated seed.

name: Thiamethoxam residue dissipation
value_or_description: Single first-order DT50 of 10 days; not applied to pelleted seed such as sugar beet.
scope: Refined quantitative analyses except pelleted seed
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Selected as moderately conservative because Canadian representativeness is uncertain.
notes: Appendix analysis links affected by XRF-0013.

name: Pelleted-seed residue persistence
value_or_description: Thiamethoxam treated as stable on pelleted seed because dissipation information is absent.
tables_using_assumption: TABLES:Table 88; TABLES:Table 89; TABLES:Table 90; TABLES:Table 159; TABLES:Table 160; TABLES:Table 161
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Described in Table 8 as highly conservative.

name: Broadcast surface fraction
value_or_description: 100% of sown seed available at the surface immediately after sowing.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Default treated as an estimate rather than a fixed field proportion.

name: Spring standard-drill surface fraction
value_or_description: 3.3% of sown seed available at the surface immediately after sowing.
supporting_evidence: de Snoo and Luttik (2004) as cited by assessment
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Substantial within/among-field variability is stated.
notes: Tables 105-107 broken links are triaged in XRF-0009.

name: Fall standard-drill surface fraction
value_or_description: 9.2% of sown seed available at the surface immediately after sowing.
supporting_evidence: de Snoo and Luttik (2004) as cited by assessment
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Substantial within/among-field variability is stated.

name: Precision-planting surface fraction
value_or_description: 0.5% of sown seed available at the surface immediately after sowing.
supporting_evidence: de Snoo and Luttik (2004) as cited by assessment
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Substantial within/among-field variability is stated.
notes: Tables 105-107 broken links are triaged in XRF-0009.

name: Surface-seed loss
value_or_description: Single first-order DT50 of 14 days for loss of surface crop seed by displacement and predation.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Selected as moderately conservative amid variable data.

name: Short-term MSA for small/medium birds
supporting_evidence: EFSA (2023) and Northern Zone guidance as cited
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Assessment states more confirmatory work is needed.

name: Short-term MSA for large birds
supporting_evidence: EFSA (2023) and Northern Zone guidance as cited
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Assessment states more confirmatory work is needed.
notes: Table 44 is captioned medium rather than large (TRC-003).

name: Bird long-term MSA
value_or_description: No separate long-term MSA applied.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Uncertainty in causal exposure window is explicit.

name: Short-term mammal MSA
scope: 15 g, 35 g and 1000 g mammal analyses

uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Assessment states more confirmatory work is needed.

name: Long-term mammal MSA
scope: 15 g, 35 g and 1000 g mammal analyses
supporting_evidence: Mammal toxicity narrative and EFSA (2023) as cited
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Relies on interpretation of duration needed for apical effects.

name: Bird receptor body weights
value_or_description: Small 20; medium 100; large 1000. Table-embedded daily food quantities reconstruct as 5.08, 19.9 and 58.2 g/d, respectively.
supporting_evidence: TABLES:Table 9; TABLES:Table 10; TABLES:Table 11; TABLES:Table 24; TABLES:Table 25; TABLES:Table 26
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Generic classes represent multiple species; food source and fresh/dry-weight basis are not stated.
notes: The values reproduce the table calculations. Candidate allometric forms reproduce the small/medium and large values, but the assessment does not state those equations or their provenance (TRC-001).

name: Mammal receptor body weights
value_or_description: Small 15; medium 35; large 1000 in quantitative tables. Table-embedded daily food quantities reconstruct as 2.18, 4.37 and 68.7 g/d, respectively.
supporting_evidence: TABLES:Table 91; TABLES:Table 92; TABLES:Table 93; TABLES:Table 99; TABLES:Table 100; TABLES:Table 101
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: MAIN-P000198 discusses a 100 g home-range example while quantitative medium class is 35 g; food source and fresh/dry-weight basis are not stated.
notes: The three daily-food values are consistent with the inferred implementation 0.235 x BW(g)^0.822, but the assessment does not state that equation or its provenance. Table 119 says 100 g; recorded as TRC-004.

name: Bird buried-seed accessibility
value_or_description: Only surface seed is quantitatively accessible; buried-seed contribution inferred negligible.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Assessment acknowledges some birds may access buried seed.

name: Mammal shallow-seed accessibility
value_or_description: For selected scenarios with sowing depth at or below 3 cm, all treated seed may be presumed available.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Buried seed is described as less accessible despite the model assumption.

name: Avian dehusking reduction
value_or_description: No default quantitative reduction in exposure.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Species/seed variability and handling exposure are stated.

name: Avian avoidance reduction
value_or_description: No default quantitative avoidance reduction; birds are assumed not to avoid treated seed.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Study transferability to Canadian products is uncertain.
notes: Appendix L references map to Appendix B under XRF-0002.

name: Alternative food availability
value_or_description: Untreated weed seed and waste grain are assumed available; dietary fraction is not automatically 100% in refined characterization.
uncertainty_stated_in_assessment: Abundance and attractiveness vary by field/species.
notes: Used as a qualitative line of evidence.

name: Estimated daily diet calculation
value_or_description: Daily food quantities reconstructed from table EDE and seed counts: birds 5.08, 19.9 and 58.2 g/d at 20, 100 and 1000 g bw; mammals 2.18, 4.37 and 68.7 g/d at 15, 35 and 1000 g bw. EDE = application rate (mg/kg seed) x food (g/d) / body weight (g) x diet fraction.
source_location: TABLES-P005831; TABLES-P005964; TABLES-P006097; TABLES-P021447; TABLES-P021582; TABLES-P021718
supporting_evidence: Quantitative table seed counts and EDE values; independently reproduced in Phase 3A
